calls.title: Hampus / Pedro AB testing LLMs
calls.summary: Intercom's meeting highlighted their robust AB testing culture, having conducted over 1,000 tests since Pedro's arrival. Every change, including minor updates, undergoes AB testing with a focus on conversation outcomes, and tests last at least one week to capture seasonal variability. The team relies on AB tests rather than offline evaluations due to biases in sample sizes. To mitigate risks, tests are now randomized at the conversation level, ensuring high-value customers are protected. Customers can customize AI behavior through guidance and procedures, and the evaluation process involves a comprehensive set of metrics to make balanced decisions.
calls.keywords: AB testing, AI experimentation, offline evaluation, conversation-based testing, customer customization, resolution rate
